verification_candidates.claim_text: People only get parasites when they travel to exotic countries.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the idea that you only get parasites when you travel to some exotic country is flat wrong?

verification_candidates.claim_text: Millions of Americans currently carry parasites, often without symptoms.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Millions of Americans carry parasites right now, often without symptoms.
verification_candidates.rationale: Prevalence claim used to sell a parasite cleanse; checkable against infection prevalence data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Millions of people in the United States have been exposed to the parasitic worm Toxocara, and most never know it.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it's estimated that millions in the United States have been exposed to Toxocara, a parasitic worm, yet most never even know it.
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific prevalence figure for a named parasite that can be checked against seroprevalence data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Parasites can enter the body through tap water, sushi, undercooked foods or contaminated produce.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Parasites do not need a plane ticket; they can enter through tap water.
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about transmission routes, notably US tap water, that shapes perceived risk.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Some parasite strains live hidden in the gut in all life stages and release toxins that sabotage energy and digestion.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Some strains live in all stages: eggs, larvae, adults, hidden in your gut, releasing toxins that sabotage your energy and digestion.
verification_candidates.rationale: Mechanistic claim linking hidden parasites to fatigue and digestive problems, used to sell a cleanse.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The Parify 30-day kit clears parasites, worms, candida and heavy metals and targets parasites in all life stages.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The kit works by clearing parasites, worms, candida, and heavy metals, targeting parasites in all life stages
verification_candidates.rationale: Efficacy claim for a commercial cleanse product.
